Airborne4-9 one based. Fixed camera/ground origin but body height changes. Keep vivid green eyes, pink brows and mouth clearly readable, no eye-covering goggles. Large hammer fully contained inside each square, generous margins. No static aura substitute. CRITICAL CANVAS REQUIREMENT: horizontal LANDSCAPE 4:3 aspect ratio, 1448 pixels wide by 1086 pixels high; each of the 4 columns and 3 rows is a 362-by-362 SQUARE. Do not use a square overall canvas. Every cell must have 10% transparent empty margin. Full hammer and impact visible. Make hammer overhead pose frame5 distinct.
